description:
Senior software developer responsible for the software design and implementation of web applications for the Interact application. Must be a modern web development specialist experienced in translating business requirements into software architecture, in addition to having strong software development skills, and have demonstrated experience in working on an Agile Scrum team. 
 Required Skills: 
 Drupal/PHP development 
 Git/GitFlow for Development process and Release Management 
 Experience with CM best practices for Drupal 
 Demonstrated Agile (Scrum) experience 

 Bachelor's degree in a related field
